title: Close four early-plan tickets as overtaken by what was built?
bluf: Four tickets from the 23 Sept plan describe work the build has since moved past: the stack decision record, the Figma flows, the prototype approval, and remediation bucket mapping. Option A: Tuesday checks each against the code and records, then proposes closing with evidence (nothing closed unseen). Option B keeps them open as written. Default if you do not tap: option A, check and propose only, no Jira change, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-16, HPSMPOC-19, HPSMPOC-20, HPSMPOC-35
